findings.description: Session.get now has an explicit `params` argument and always forwards `params=params` to `request`, defaulting to None. If `GetKwargs` still includes `params`, the typed signature is inconsistent, but runtime behavior is unchanged.
findings.rationale: Passing `params=None` is equivalent to the `request` default, and `params` can no longer appear twice in kwargs because it is now a named parameter. No concrete behavioral trigger exists.
